diagrams.title: System boundaries
diagrams.description: Local city, workers and PostgreSQL with the optional IAM-authenticated GCP judgement boundary.
diagrams.source:
...@common
direction: down
grid-columns: 2
horizontal-gap: 168
local: 01 / Local Docker {
  direction: down
  class: local
  operator: "Operator UI\nTrusted controller"
  world: "Synthetic city\nPhysical world engine"
  workers: "Scoped Python\nLocalAgent workers"
  db: "PostgreSQL\nDomain · queue · memory\nBudgets · audit" {shape: cylinder}
  client: "CloudJudge client\nAudience-bound ID token\nValidated verdict + usage"
  operator -> world
  operator -> workers
  world <-> db
  workers <-> db
  workers -> client: "Explicit GCP\njudge mode"
}
cloud: 02 / Optional GCP · Terraform {
  direction: down
  class: cloud
  iam: "Cloud Run IAM\nCaller identity"
  gateway: "Cloud Run\nJudgement container"
  model: "Google publisher model\nVertex REST"
  image: "Artifact Registry\nImmutable image digest"

  image -> gateway: Image {style.stroke-dash: 4}
  gateway -> model: "Runtime service\naccount ADC"
  gateway -> logs
}

(** <-> **)[*].style: {...${edge-style}}

flowchart TB
    subgraph Local["Local Docker environment"]
        Operator["Operator UI and trusted controller"]
        World["Synthetic city and physical world engine"]
        Workers["Scoped Python LocalAgent workers"]
        DB[("PostgreSQL: domain state, queue, memory, budgets and audit")]
        Client["Optional CloudJudge client"]

        Operator --> World
        World <--> DB
        Workers <--> DB
        Workers -->|"Explicit GCP judge mode"| Client

diagrams.title: Meal handoffs
diagrams.description: Queued household, restaurant, market, dispatcher and courier handoffs with explicit substitution consent and physical arrival.
diagrams.source:
...@common
shape: sequence_diagram
household: Household
restaurant: Restaurant
market: Market
dispatcher: Dispatcher
courier: Courier
world: "Physical\nworld"
sourcing: 01 / Source ingredients {
  class: local
  household -> restaurant: household.call
  restaurant -> market: market.request
  market.stock: "Reserve own stock or\nforward to unvisited market"
  market -> restaurant: ingredient.arrived
}
consent: 02 / Substitution + cooking {
  class: local
  restaurant -> household: Replacement offer
  household -> restaurant: Explicit approval
  restaurant.stock: "Cook from arrived,\nreserved ingredients"
}
delivery: 03 / Brief + deliver {
  class: local
  restaurant -> dispatcher: basket.ready
  dispatcher -> courier: courier.briefed
  courier -> dispatcher: courier.accepted
  world -> dispatcher: "delivery.arrived\nAfter road traversal"
  dispatcher -> dispatcher: "dispatch.complete\nRecord delivered"
  household -> household: "meal.delivery\nCheck canonical job"
}
(** -> **)[*].style: {...${edge-style}}
diagrams.reference:
sequenceDiagram
    participant H as Household agent
    participant R as Restaurant agent
    participant M as Market agent
    participant D as Dispatcher
    participant C as Courier agent
    participant W as Physical world
    H->>R: household.call for pizza
    R->>M: market.request for missing ingredient
    Note over M: Reserve own stock or forward to an unvisited market
    M->>R: ingredient.arrived after transfer
    Note over H,R: A replacement requires explicit household approval
    Note over R: Cook only from arrived, reserved ingredients
    R->>D: basket.ready
    D->>C: courier.briefed
    C->>D: courier.accepted
    W->>D: delivery.arrived after road traversal
    D->>D: dispatch.complete records delivered status
    H->>H: meal.delivery checks canonical job status

labels: Reserve own stock or forward to unvisited market

diagrams.title: An agent's transaction
diagrams.description: A committed attempt reservation precedes the atomic transaction for tool effects, memory, outgoing events and ACK.
diagrams.reference:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Trusted controller
    participant A as Scoped LocalAgent
    participant Q as PostgreSQL queue
    participant T as Domain tools and memory
    C->>Q: Publish an addressed event
    A->>Q: Claim with role subscriptions
    Q-->>A: Event, attempt and fenced lease token
    A->>Q: Reserve attempt and full tool allowance
    Note over A,Q: Reservation commits before handling
    A->>Q: Begin effects transaction and validate lease
    A->>T: Read authoritative facts and current-context memory
    A->>T: Execute allowed actions and append memory revisions
    A->>Q: Record decision and publish outgoing events
    A->>Q: ACK in the same transaction
    Note over Q,T: Commit together, or roll back together

labels: 03 / Atomic effects · commit or roll back

diagrams.title: Durable inference lifecycle
diagrams.description: Short transactions persist request, dispatch and result around provider I/O. Fresh validation commits an approved or denied receipt, memory, outbox and ACK atomically; an uncertain dispatch is never automatically resent.
diagrams.reference:
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Scoped judge worker
    participant D as PostgreSQL
    participant P as Bounded provider
    A->>D: Prepare immutable request under fenced lease
    D-->>A: Commit request, context and local proposal
    A->>D: Commit dispatch marker and call allowance
    Note over A,D: Close connection before remote I/O
    A->>P: Invoke with sanitized numeric facts
    P-->>A: Schema-validated verdict
    A->>D: Save result in a short fenced transaction
    D-->>A: Commit saved result
    A->>D: Re-read current state and validate saved proposal
    Note over A,D: Apply effects, memory, outbox and ACK atomically
    D-->>A: Commit completed event

labels: PREPARED Immutable request + proposal Precondition hash committed
IN_FLIGHT Dispatch marker + one-call budget Commit before provider I/O
SUCCEEDED Validated result saved Short transaction
UNKNOWN / FAIL CLOSED Never resend automatically Apply a denied review
Fresh Queue.process transaction Recheck saved result + facts Deadline + candidate
DENIED / NO RETRY Stale, unknown or refused No reassignment
APPLIED Approved or denied receipt Effects + memory + outbox + ACK One atomic transaction

diagrams.title: Fleet recovery and parcel custody
diagrams.description: A queued world failure leads to a scoped persisted judge review. The dispatcher applies that review, rechecks SQL assignment constraints and requires courier acceptance before checkpoint collection and physical delivery.
diagrams.source:
...@common
direction: down
grid-columns: 3
horizontal-gap: 152
review: 01 / Judge review {
  direction: down
  class: local
  failure: "World failure\nParcel at safe checkpoint"
  candidate: "Scoped judge\nLocal courier + route\ncandidate"
  verdict: "recovery.reviewed\nPersist bounded SQL review\nLocal rules / optional\nsaved provider verdict\nFeasibility checked"
  failure -> candidate: "delivery.failed\nQueued"
  candidate -> verdict
}
decision: 02 / Dispatcher decision {
  direction: down
  class: local
  apply: "Apply current-attempt review\nDenied: abandon at checkpoint"
  retry: "dispatch.retry\nQueued · wait if fleet busy"
  gate: "Fresh SQL assignment checks\nReview · free online courier\nRoute · deadline · retry limits"
  apply -> retry: Approved
  retry -> gate
}
movement: 03 / Physical handoff {
  direction: down
  class: local
  assign: "Atomic assignment\nNew attempt + scoped briefing"
  accept: "courier.briefed\ncourier.accepted\nBefore departure"
  travel: "Collect same parcel\nat checkpoint\nWorld: delivery.arrived"
  complete: "Dispatcher confirms\ndelivery.completed" {class: durable}
  assign -> accept
  accept -> travel
  travel -> complete
}
review -> decision: Queued
decision -> movement: "Gates\npass"
(** -> **)[*].style: {...${edge-style}}
diagrams.reference:
flowchart TB
    subgraph Review["01 / Judge review"]
        Failure["World failure: parcel retained at safe checkpoint"]
        Candidate["Scoped judge computes local courier and route candidate"]
        Verdict["Local rules or saved optional provider verdict; SQL persists bounded review"]
        Failure -->|"Queued delivery.failed"| Candidate
        Candidate --> Verdict
    end
    subgraph Decision["02 / Dispatcher decision"]
        Apply["Apply matching current-attempt review"]
        Held["Denied: abandoned; parcel stays at checkpoint"]
        Retry["Queued dispatch.retry; wait if fleet is busy"]
        Gate["Fresh SQL checks: approved review, free online courier, route, deadline and retry limits"]
        Apply -->|"Denied"| Held
        Apply -->|"Approved"| Retry
        Retry --> Gate
    end
    subgraph Movement["03 / Physical handoff"]
        Assign["Atomic new attempt, courier assignment and scoped briefing"]
        Accept["Queued courier.briefed and courier.accepted before departure"]
        Travel["Collect same parcel at checkpoint; world records delivery.arrived"]
        Complete["Dispatcher confirms delivery.completed"]
        Assign --> Accept --> Travel --> Complete
    end
    Verdict -->|"Queued recovery.reviewed"| Apply
    Gate -->|"All checks pass"| Assign

labels: World failure Parcel at safe checkpoint
Scoped judge Local courier + route candidate
recovery.reviewed Persist bounded SQL review Local rules / optional saved provider verdict Feasibility checked
Apply current-attempt review Denied: abandon at checkpoint
dispatch.retry Queued · wait if fleet busy
Fresh SQL assignment checks Review · free online courier Route · deadline · retry limits
Atomic assignment New attempt + scoped briefing
Collect same parcel at checkpoint World: delivery.arrived
